concerns.text: FR-008 (validate local adjacency graph against ground truth, edge overlap ≥95%) is not covered by any task. T007 mentions graph validation but is marked as dependent on T006 and lacks the specific 'edge overlap ≥95%' metric requirement found in FR-008 and SC-006. A dedicated task or explicit expansion of T007 is required to satisfy FR-008.

FR-009 (compute path-level betweenness centrality for each route) is tagged on T015, but T015 is marked as dependent on T006 (which is missing/rejected in the analyze report). If T006 is not implemented, FR-009 has no executable path. Additionally, T014 depends on T015 output; if T015 is blocked, the evaluation logic in T014 cannot satisfy the 'consume per-route topological complexity metrics' requirement of FR-003/FR-009.

FR-001 (download and preprocess, filtering for four Chinese cities, top-N vocab) is partially covered by T006, but T006 is marked as rejected/missing in the analyze report. Without a valid T006, the foundational data pipeline for FR-001 is unimplemented.
FR-002 (implement lightweight encoder-only model) is covered by T012, but T012 is marked as rejected/missing. This leaves the core P1 user story without an implementation task.
FR-006 (handle <UNKNOWN> tokens) is covered by T016, but T016 depends on T006 (preprocess). If T006 is missing, T016 cannot be executed. A standalone task or explicit dependency resolution is needed.

FR-007 (apply Bonferroni correction) is tagged on T023, but T023 is part of a chain dependent on the foundational data (T006) and evaluation (T014). If upstream tasks are missing, FR-007 is effectively unimplemented.

FR-005 (profile inference latency/memory) is covered by T028, but T028 depends on the lightweight model (T012) which is missing. No fallback or independent profiling task exists for the model architecture itself.

Task T007 is described as 'Implement data/graph_utils.py to build the local adjacency graph and validate it... (FR-008)'. However, the task is marked as dependent on T006 and the analyze report indicates T006 is missing. The task description should be clarified to ensure it explicitly includes the 'edge overlap ≥95%' check required by FR-008, or a separate task should be created if T007 is insufficient.
